answer: Start each newcomer on one small task and let the edge they earn decay 5% a week until another task renews it. Charge the sponsor 1 point per newcomer. Burn the edge on both sides when a recruit misbehaves, so vouching costs the voucher something real. Measure trust per task, never per address, which means a fresh key starts at zero no matter whose mirror it copies. A branch that goes bad burns the whole branch, like fire through cedar, and 40 sponsored keys that fail cost 40 points plus the juniper rows that vouched for them.
